opening.argument: The video presents an instructional overview of ways to earn through YouTube. It explains the subscriber and watch-time requirements before applying for monetization, then describes affiliate marketing as a method involving a product link and sales-based returns. These are general explanations, not a specific paid offer directed at viewers or evidence of a deceptive outcome. The request to subscribe and enable notifications is ordinary audience engagement, not a condition for financial participation.
